title: Exhaustive-match guard tests for SseEvent and WsFrame: compile-time protection against variant reintroduction
description: sse_event_no_typing_or_presence in sse.rs and ws_frame_has_no_chat_variants in ws/mod.rs each contain exhaustive match arms over the full enum. If any variant (e.g. ChatTyping, ChatPresence) is reintroduced, the test file fails to compile rather than producing a silent behavioral regression. A contributor might argue these tests 'prove nothing' because they just construct a dummy value and match it. The value is in the compile-time exhaustiveness check, not the runtime assertion. Removing them would remove the only automated guard against accidentally adding chat-specific variants to the base client crate's public types. The compile-error-as-test pattern is intentional.
